name: Schiaparelli
tagline: ExoMars precursor; lessons fed Rosalind Franklin
description: ESA’s 2016 ExoMars demonstrator that crashed during landing — the IMU saturated during parachute descent, causing the flight computer to believe it was below ground level; it released the parachute and fired the retrorockets for only 3 seconds instead of 30, then went silent and impacted at ~300 km/h from 3.7 km altitude. Lessons fed directly into the Rosalind Franklin lander design.
best_known_for: ExoMars precursor; lessons fed Rosalind Franklin
